predicate.description: A predicate name. Membership is checked at tier 2 against ontology/l1.json; this only rules out strings that could never be one. Deliberately not an enum: the predicate set belongs to the ontology and changes with it, so a list here would be a second copy that drifts.

source.description: IRI of a node. Usually in this document; a graph split across layers may reference a node a sibling document defines, and tier 2 resolves those across the set of documents it is given.

target.description: IRI of a node. Usually in this document; a graph split across layers may reference a node a sibling document defines, and tier 2 resolves those across the set of documents it is given.

qualifier.description: A label on the relationship. Where the ontology enumerates the permitted values, tier 2 checks them. Where the predicate declares `openQualifier` the label is free text authored in the source artefact — a BPMN sequence flow's branch name, for instance — and no vocabulary constrains it.

derivation.description: Identical to traceability-link.schema.json, deliberately. derived: mechanically produced, no choice involved. inferred: a rule that could reasonably have gone another way. decided: the source is silent and someone chose. Every node and edge in a graph is one of the three, and the third is the one a reviewer needs to find.

location.description: file:line, a spreadsheet sheet and cell, or a BPMN element id.

artifact.description: The generated artifact affected, where one exists.

by.description: Who made the judgement. Required by tier 2 when derivation is decided: a person's choice between candidates is only reviewable if it says whose it was.

at.description: When the judgement was made. Required by tier 2 when derivation is decided.

evidence.description: Where this came from in the DAK. Required on anything not mechanically derived, for the same reason a failing check must quote its source: an assertion with nothing to point at is the confident wrong answer the package exists to prevent.

properties.description: Fields of the statement itself, as opposed to of either endpoint. A cross-format join carries `resolutionStatus` (unresolved | resolved | ambiguous) and `matchedOn` here: that a BPMN pool name was matched against an ActorDefinition title is a property of the match, not of the pool or of the persona. Tier 2 checks `resolutionStatus` — its value, and that a join claiming `resolved` neither points at a placeholder nor lacks evidence. Other keys are unconstrained.

Edge.description: One reified statement. Reified rather than written as a plain node property because an edge here carries a qualifier, a derivation and its evidence, and a plain property has nowhere to put them.

title: EdgeSchema
description: Generated from `EdgeSchema` in L1/schemas/graph.ts, which is authoritative. Published because it is an exported Zod `*Schema` (owner ruling 2026-10-05) — which says it is reachable, not that it is stable.
